acquisition method: oxonium ions were used to sense the presence of a glycopeptide and then trigger the generation of an HCD MS/MS spectrum
cleavage agent: then digested with Glu-C (C-terminal cleavage of glutamic acid, 1:50, enzyme:protein) and trypsin (C-terminal cleavage at arginine and lysine, 1:50, enzyme:protein)
collision energy: initial MS2 scans (normalized collision energy (NCE) 30%) were acquired
fragmentation method: For high energy collisional dissociation (HCD) analyses
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer
NanoUPLC-MS/MS analyses were performed on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer
labeling: Ratios of unlabeled and 18O-labeled peptides were based on peak heights in the MS1 spectra
precursor tolerance: Mass tolerance was set to 10 and 20 ppm at the MS and MS/MS levels, respectively.
fragment tolerance: Mass tolerance was set to 10 and 20 ppm at the MS and MS/MS levels, respectively.
ptm: Carbamidomethylation (Cys) fixed; Met oxidation variable; protein N-terminal acetylation variable
Carbamidomethylation (Cys) was set as a fixed modification, whereas Met oxidation and protein N-terminal acetylation were defined as variable modifications.
reduction reagent: each IgG sample (5 µg) was reduced with 10 mM of dithiolthreitol
reduction concentration: each IgG sample (5 µg) was reduced with 10 mM of dithiolthreitol
